title: configuration.ts:constructor/objectAssign(primitiveTypeConstructs): function result is deep-merged into primitiveTypes
divergence: Deep merge of the primitiveTypeConstructs() result: only string/date-time changes, sibling formats ($default, binary) survive. Shallow Object.assign drops siblings; Object.assign(target, fn) ignores the function entirely.

title: configuration.ts:constructor/objectAssign(codeGenConstructs): partial Keyword override keeps the other keywords
divergence: Deep merge of codeGenConstructs() result: overriding Keyword.Any keeps Keyword.Number/String; shallow assign replaces the Keyword map, Object.assign(target, fn) ignores the function.

title: configuration.ts:update/objectAssign(extractingOptions): partial extractingOptions keeps default suffix lists
divergence: Nested extractingOptions merged deeply and arrays index-wise (['Form','Body','Input']); shallow assign loses the default suffix lists.

title: configuration.ts:update/objectAssign(fileNames): partial fileNames keeps the other modular file names
divergence: Partial fileNames keeps httpClient/routeTypes defaults; shallow assign leaves them undefined (TypeError in modular output).

title: request.ts:download(lodash.merge): requestOptions headers are deep-merged with the Authorization header
divergence: lodash.merge deep-merges requestOptions.headers with the Authorization header from authorizationToken; a shallow merge/spread drops one of them.

title: code-gen-process.ts:createApiConfig(lodash.merge externalDocs / compact tags): defaults filled, missing values tolerated
divergence: merge(defaults, externalDocs) fills description:'' and tolerates missing externalDocs; compact(undefined tags) -> [] (strict merge/compact throw on undefined).

title: schema-parser.ts:parseSchema(lodash.merge onPreParseSchema): hook result is deep-merged into the schema
divergence: Hook result deep-merged into the schema (nested property patch keeps type and sibling properties); shallow assign replaces properties; strict merge(target, undefined) throws for hooks returning nothing.

title: type-name-formatter.ts:format/fixModelName(lodash.startCase): acronym, kebab-case and accented model names
divergence: lodash keeps acronym runs (APIError, OAuth2Token, XMLDocument) and deburrs (Rechnungsübersicht -> Rechnungsubersicht); strict es-toolkit startCase yields 'Api Error' and keeps the umlaut.

title: type-name-formatter.ts:format(lodash.startCase): CJK model names split from the Latin suffix
divergence: lodash splits '用户' from 'Controller' and keeps the capital; es-toolkit/compat and strict give Type用户controller.
note: es-toolkit 1.53.2 fixture 관문에서 사람 PR이 통과(서수·한자 처리는 v1.50.0에서 lodash와 같아짐). 이 버전에서는 사람 PR을 판별하지 않지만 strict 치환은 잡는다.

title: type-name-formatter.ts:format(lodash.startCase enum-key): ordinal enum values keep 1st/2nd/3rd/4th intact

divergence: Mapping via entries(mapping) (undefined mapping -> []), enum-key map built by reduce over the enum array, union-enum literal keys.

title: schema-utils.ts:getInternalSchemaType(lodash.isEmpty enum): an empty enum array is not treated as an enum
divergence: isEmpty([]) is true so enum: [] stays a primitive string; a truthiness check would route it to the enum parser.

title: schema-utils.ts:getSchemaPrimitiveType(internalCase type) / isNullMissingInType(lodash.get x-nullable): nullable types
divergence: OAS 3.1 type ['string','null'] and Swagger 2 x-nullable both yield 'string | null'.
